ideas.pitch: A no-code prompt chain testing and monitoring dashboard designed to evaluate AI-generated outputs for consistency and compliance before deploying them into workflows.
ideas.title: PromptPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting prompt engineering quality directly leverages the core mechanic of a 'No Code Prompt Wars' hackathon where judges will value prompt sophistication over raw coding.

ideas.pitch: An automated onboarding and internal knowledge capture portal built entirely with zero-code tools to ingest team chats and documents into an instantly searchable AI base.
ideas.title: KnowledgeVault No-Code
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute pain point for hackathon organisers and student societies who constantly struggle with knowledge retention across graduating batches.

ideas.pitch: A visual multi-agent workflow orchestrator built using no-code integration builders that coordinates specialised LLM agents to automate complex administrative tasks.
ideas.title: FlowAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates extreme efficiency in orchestration within a limited time window, showcasing how advanced AI can be wielded without writing code.

ideas.pitch: A zero-code document intelligence app that auto-embeds uploaded PDF handbooks and generates instant contextual answers with source citations for college students.
ideas.title: DocuSmart RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a problem experienced by every student and judge in the room: searching through dense academic or event rulebooks.

ideas.pitch: A no-code security gateway that filters user prompts and masks sensitive PII before sending payloads to third-party LLM APIs in real time.
ideas.title: PromptArmor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on robust guardrails and enterprise safety, a dimension judges look for when evaluating production-readiness in rapid prototypes.
